audit.why: 6/10 and the Trundle-early / Skill-4-5 / Trundle-6 shape is right: Chomp out-trades her before she has an energy pool to chain casts, Pillar of Ice answers a dash-based kit, and Subjugate at 6 beats a champion with no way to escape a 650-range targeted steal once she has committed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and power window was hung on 'Repeating Dashes', an ability that does not exist, so none of the timings could be checked against a real cooldown.
audit.why: Ambessa's kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q, 14/13/12/11/10), Repudiation (W, 18/17/16/15/14), Lacerate (E, 13/12/11/10/9) and Public Execution (R, 130/115/100). The dash windows are Lacerate at 13s and the passive step, not a single 'dashes' ability.
audit.corrected: Rebuilt every spike and window on Lacerate 13s, Repudiation 18s and Public Execution 130s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (a) 'Repeating Dashes' is a fabricated ability name used ~20 times across the full layer — the packet defect list already flagged that no real Ambessa ability is ever named. (b) The content layer repeatedly calls her dash a 'W-dash'; W is Repudiation, a shield-and-slam, and the dashes come from Drakehound's Step (P) and Lacerate (E). (c) breakdown.mid tells the player Ambessa will 'take the knock-up' from Pillar — Pillar of Ice has no knockup, only impassable terrain and a slow.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: Repudiation is 'gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground'. Lacerate: 'Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash'. Pillar of Ice: 'becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units' — terrain, not displacement, which is exactly what stops a dash-based kit. Also unrecorded and worth having: Public Execution 'blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in a line', so being the closest body in a line means she takes someone behind you instead.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' replaced with the real ability, every 'W-dash' rewritten as Lacerate / Drakehound's Step, the fabricated knockup removed, and the farthest-target rule on Public Execution added to the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track it before every engage' with no ability and no number attached.
audit.why: Lacerate 13s at rank 1 is the punishable window; Repudiation is 18s and Public Execution 130s.

edits.before: Level 1 through 3 is a genuine knife-fight — Ambessa's empowered-hit weaving is just as threatening as your Chomp start, so don't open with an all-in. Take Q at level 1 and bite her on every last-hit attempt, banking the flat damage and the AD steal without overcommitting. At level 2 drop Frozen Domain before you trade, not during — you want the speed and attack-speed buff counting from the first hit, and you want her W dashes landing inside the zone where your move speed erases the repositioning advantage. When you hit level 3, Pillar is what closes this out: throw it directly behind her after she lands a dash, not in front, because Ambessa's instinct is always to exit through the entry point; cut the exit and she takes the full trade in your domain.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best window before either ultimate arrives. Q's damage and AS steal are ranking up, Frozen Domain is up frequently, and Ambessa has no answer to an extended fight inside the ice zone short of her W dashes — which your Pillar is sitting ready to counter. Force her to choose: disengage through Pillar and take the knock-up, or stay in the domain and bleed the AD steal for another three Chomps. At 6 the math tips hard in your favor: R at the very start of the all-in, before she has spent any of her dashes, and let the drained armor and MR compound every hit that follows. The one thing that kills you here is burning Frozen Domain before she commits — place it on engagement, not before.

At 6 the math tips hard in your favor: R at the very start of the all-in, before she has spent any of her dashes, and let the drained armor and MR compound every hit that follows. The one thing that kills you here is burning Frozen Domain before she commits — place it on engagement, not before.

edits.before: Once Ambessa completes Eclipse, the burst potential in a single W-dash combo becomes genuinely dangerous, and she scales into teamfights better than you do. Respect the spike, keep Frozen Domain and Pillar available as a pair, and never fight her without Subjugate up — that is the one condition where she simply wins. At two items your duel threat is back: Trinity into Iceborn means every Chomp procs Spellblade and slows her simultaneously, and Subjugate strips her stats the moment she tries to go all-in on you. Split-push and force her into side-lane duels where your R is the deciding factor; avoid five-versus-five fights where her mobility lets her pick the target instead of you picking her.

notes: This was the worst entry in the slice. 'Repeating Dashes' is a fabricated ability name and appeared ~20 times across the full layer; it is now replaced with the real Lacerate (E, 13/12/11/10/9) and Drakehound's Step (P). The content layer's repeated 'W-dash' was also wrong — W is Repudiation, a shield-and-slam, not a dash. Removed a fabricated 'knock-up' on Pillar of Ice from breakdown.mid. NOT written because it contradicts Riot's own text: _missing-interactions.json lists Ambessa as needing anti-heal via Public Execution, but Riot's Public Execution description contains no healing at all — the derived heal flag looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire, so no anti-heal advice was added. Same for the grounding flag on Repudiation, which Riot's description does not support.
